description: A powerful and original deck. Me and my friend (Mike Kimosh) have been trying to make an MBO that works and this is the version we have come up with. If you have seen a deck like this before it's because Mike posted an earlier version of it.

notes: Posted 28 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (7)': Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million, Yavin 4, Yavin 4: Docking Bay, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Strike Planning, Squadron Assignments and Great Shot, Kid!; these count toward the 60. The three Effects are pulled by Heading For The Medical Frigate, so no single starting effect is shown.

Posted 'Massasi Base op's/One In A Million' dested Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million; 'Death Star' and 'Kiffex' in a Light deck dested the Light pages Death Star (Special Edition) and Kiffex (Jabba's Palace); 'Yavin 4 War Room' Yavin 4: Massassi War Room; 'Yavin 4 HeadQuarters' Yavin 4: Massassi Headquarters; 'Death Star Trench' Death Star: Trench.

Posted 'EPP Obi' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Wedge Antilles,RSL' Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader; 'ASP Droid' the Light Special Edition droid ASP-707 (Ayesspee); 'R2D2 in Red 5' Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'XWing Cannon' X-wing Laser Cannon; 'Houijix' Houjix; 'Hoijix/Out Of Nowhere' the combo Houjix & Out Of Nowhere.
The heading 'Other (1)' is a section header (its card is Attack Run), not a card; removed.

The strategy's UPDATE swaps both A Jedi's Resiliences for Bacta Tank and Corran Horn, Sergeant Brooks Carlson for Lieutenant Blount, and an Arcona for a Sergeant Brooks Carlson; the list is kept as originally published.
